## Checklist

- [ ] The PR targets a dedicated `feature/`, `fix/`, or `chore/` branch.
- [ ] The linked issue contains clear acceptance criteria.
- [ ] Tests cover happy paths and relevant failure or regression cases.
- [ ] Lint, tests, application check, and required container checks pass.
- [ ] Configuration uses environment variables and no secret is committed.
- [ ] Documentation is updated when behavior or operations change.
- [ ] Another team member has completed a useful technical review.
